  strict: true

  transitions:
    initial: [open]
    open: [in_progress, blocked, deferred, closed]
    in_progress: [in_review, open, blocked, deferred]
    in_review: [closed, rework]
    rework: [in_progress]
    blocked: [open, in_progress]
    deferred: [open]
    closed: [open]
  status_groups:
    ready: [open, rework]
  required_fields:
    "open -> in_progress": [acceptance_criteria_present]
    in_review: [acceptance_criteria, transition_comment]
    closed: [transition_comment]
  gates:
    "in_review -> closed":
      require_all:
        - min_reviewers: 1
    "open -> closed":
      require_all:
        - min_reviewers: 1
